title: Consciousness is a fundamental and ubiquitous feature of the physical world

statements.text: Consciousness is fundamental, not derived from anything non-conscious, and ubiquitous: at least some kinds of fundamental physical entities, perhaps electrons and quarks, or the universe as a whole, have experience of some extremely basic kind.

sources.quote: Panpsychism is the view that consciousness is fundamental and ubiquitous.
Panpsychism, the view that fundamental physical entities are conscious, is a highly probable theory of the natural world.
